_about: Members differ (Kris 2026-10-26: different models react differently): tune each member from ITS replays (python -m crew.guard <job> --replay), keyed _seen notes record why. Limits the guard (crew/guard.py) enforces on EVERY OpenCode job while it runs. Software counts and stops the job; no AI reads this. For a number the TIGHTEST of defaults, job type and member wins. PROGRESS = a code edit that went through, or a progress_command that exited 0; reading and searching are not progress. A job that keeps making progress may pass budget_tokens and go on up to the ceilings; one that stops making progress, or keeps failing, is stopped. tokens = fresh input + output + cached input re-read (every step re-sends the conversation). Set from today's jobs (2026-10-26): the passing builds never went more than 9 steps without progress or repeated an error more than twice; the two failed ones went 18 and 23 steps and repeated an error 4 times.
